subject: [hw] IP -> lead: 5 libSystem symbols missing from gpu/video/sdk/symbols.txt (J02 proved the link; I need them for build_ios.sh)
body:
Request (J02 hit it independently, I reproduced the need): gpu/video/sdk/symbols.txt has no _ioctl, _printf, _sscanf, _strerror, ___stdoutp, and gpu/video/sdk/lib/libSystem.tbd therefore cannot satisfy the JPEG tool or the daemon. All five are libSystem exports on iOS 16 (J02 dry-ran both links with a local extra.tbd: dylib and executable link NOUNDEFS).

Proposed exact lines for gpu/video/sdk/symbols.txt (make_tbds folds /usr/lib/system/libsystem_* into libSystem):
  /usr/lib/system/libsystem_kernel.dylib   _ioctl
  /usr/lib/system/libsystem_c.dylib        _printf
  /usr/lib/system/libsystem_c.dylib        _sscanf
  /usr/lib/system/libsystem_c.dylib        _strerror
  /usr/lib/system/libsystem_c.dylib        ___stdoutp

I also need, for vcodecd/cli on iOS: _pthread_cond_broadcast/_pthread_cond_destroy/_pthread_cond_init/_pthread_cond_signal/_pthread_cond_timedwait/_pthread_cond_wait, _pthread_self, _sigaction, _gettimeofday, _strtoull, _strncmp, _stat (sys/stat.h exists in sdk/sysinc). I am listing the full set in gpu/hwcodec/daemon/sdk_symbols.txt (my file) and building with a supplemental /tmp TBD generated from it, so no gpu/video edit is needed for my acceptance. Your call whether to fold them into sdk/symbols.txt; the lead verifies each name against the phones dyld cache before install, as the file says.

Also FYI: build_ios.sh (gpu/hwcodec) will read gpu/video/sdk read-only; it will not run make_tbds.py (that writes) and will put every object under /tmp/n2hw-ip/ios.
